new_findings.claim: The repair makes the invariant suite browser- and Playwright-dependent, violating its pure-code contract.
new_findings.evidence: evals/adversarial/ui-rendered-narrow.json:4 tags the new case invariant, while src/browser/eval_adapter.py:1888 and 1896-1902 import Playwright and launch Chromium; CLAUDE.md:50 defines invariant as pure code. In this worktree's base Python, directly running the case fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'playwright'.
new_findings.repro: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import json; from src.browser.eval_adapter import run_case; print(run_case(json.load(open("evals/adversarial/ui-rendered-narrow.json"))))'
new_findings.acceptance: Keep the rendered browser regression in fast (or another browser-capable suite) but remove it from invariant, or replace its invariant-path check with a genuinely pure-code check while retaining focused rendered coverage.
